profile.model: Alphabet's venture arm invests in therapeutics, diagnostics, devices and health tech, from formation through later rounds. It incubates companies with entrepreneurs-in-residence (ROME Therapeutics and Verve Therapeutics came out of this program), co-leads launch rounds with partners such as ARCH and Lux, and often leads early rounds of platform companies.
profile.summary: GV has invested in healthcare since 2009 and has backed many prominent genetic-medicine and AI-biology companies, including Beam, Verve, Prime Medicine and Isomorphic Labs. Its exits include Foundation Medicine and Flatiron Health to Roche and Verve to Lilly.
